scientific_integrity: Analytic proof supplied. Algebraic and numerical checks are supplementary, not exhaustive or independent proof. Public source date is the original arXiv first submission.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns \(0<x_0\le1\), \(0<s<1\), and \(\beta\le\theta(1+\alpha)\), with an above-threshold existence comparison. Critical \(1/n\) amplitudes are conditional on the prey limit being one, and an open set of such trajectories is proved. The revised 2026 subscription journal text could not be compared in full.
title: Global predator exclusion and a universal critical recovery law in a double-Allee map
